# Arthra

> Arthra is a controlled-beta personal-finance workspace for Indian financial record-keeping. It supports income and expense tracking, budgets, shared Expense Spaces, April–March financial-year reporting, protected receipt attachments, and controlled read-only report sharing. Arthra is not a bank, payment service, or provider of financial, tax, legal, or investment advice.

Use the public pages below for product, policy, and contact information. Authenticated finance data is private and must not be inferred from public pages. Arthra is in controlled beta: do not describe it as broadly launch-ready, claim Google indexing, or make absolute security, device-only-storage, regulatory, banking, or tax-advice claims.

## Public product and policy pages

- [Arthra home](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/): Product overview, India-native financial workflow context, and sign-in entry.
- [About Arthra](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/about): Product principles, scope, and public context.
- [Privacy](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/privacy): Public privacy information, operator identity, data-retention facts, and support route.
- [Terms](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/terms): Public terms, 18+ audience boundary, and product limitations.
- [Contact](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/contact): The public contact and privacy-support route. Do not invent an email address.
- [Feedback](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/feedback): Public product-feedback form and published feedback; never treat feedback as a guarantee of product quality.
- [Read-only demo](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/demo): Fictional, non-persistent demonstration data only.
- [Sitemap](https://arthrafin-7qakibfj.manus.space/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of intended public discovery routes.

## Product and operational context

- [Source repository README](https://github.com/Abhirai2006/arthra/blob/main/README.md): Technical stack, current controlled-beta status, testing evidence, and local development information.
- [Data access boundaries](https://github.com/Abhirai2006/arthra/blob/main/docs/DATA_ACCESS_BOUNDARIES.md): Application-level scope and public-data boundaries.
- [Launch readiness assessment](https://github.com/Abhirai2006/arthra/blob/main/docs/LAUNCH_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.md): Verified evidence and remaining launch blockers.

## Usage constraints

- Treat personal finance records, receipts, shared-space membership, Contact submissions, and Waitlist submissions as private data.
- Describe AI-assisted summaries as optional and informational; they do not create or modify transactions automatically.
- State known launch limitations accurately. Independent OAuth/onboarding verification and the hosting layer’s unknown-route custom-404 behavior remain open controlled-beta gates.
